channel.title: Refrigerated & Frozen Foods - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Refrigerated & Frozen Foods (refrigeratedfrozenfood.com)

item.title: Joyce Farms Launches Signature Angus Heritage Beef Program
item.description: The program will replace Joyce Farms' limited 100% grass-fed Aberdeen Angus Heritage Beef line, allowing the company to better meet demand while preserving its hallmark Nothing Added Ever commitment and third-party animal welfare certifications.

item.title: New Eriez Kit to Support Food Safety Retail Compliance
item.description: Developed in response to escalating food safety and quality demands—particularly within UK and European retail supply chains— to deliver exceptional inspection accuracy, traceability and reliability.

item.title: Kevin's Natural Foods Debuts Limited-Time Game Day Flavors
item.description: Three new options bring the excitement of game day food with high-quality ingredients and five-minute prep.

item.title: Alta Dena Dairy Debuts High-Protein MIlk
item.description: Each half-gallon jug provides 15 grams of protein per serving — 87% more than regular milk — while remaining lactose-free for easy digestion.

item.title: RefrigiWear Releases Gloves Designed for Cold Storage
item.description: Built tough for walk-in freezers and refrigerated warehouses, these gloves deliver lasting comfort and performance when the work doesn’t stop for the cold.

item.title: Reactive Survival to Proactive Precision: Optimizing the Cold Chain in 2026 & Beyond
item.description: Successful cold chain companies will prioritize network optimization and rigorous automation feasibility evaluation over generic technology adoption.

item.title: Deadline Extended: Is Your New Refrigerated & Frozen Product a Winner?
item.description: Products receiving the top-three votes will be featured on the R&FF website, newsletter, eMag and more.

item.title: Natural Grocers Expands House Brand Frozen Fruit & Smoothie Blends
item.description: Whether blended, baked, simmered, or sprinkled on top, fruit plays an important role in delivering dietary fiber, antioxidants, vitamins and natural sweetness without compromise.

item.title: AFFI Appoints Seiling as COO and Head of Strategic Initiatives
item.description: In this role, Seiling will oversee AFFI’s core operations and lead the advancement of key organization priorities and support continued growth for the frozen food industry.

item.title: New Snickers Ice Cream Minis Brings Maximum Satisfaction
item.description: Snickers Ice Cream Minis come in five multi-textural flavors, making it easier than ever to enjoy a moment of chill, whether it's a quick afternoon treat or a sweet bite on the go.
